channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Texas is still the binding US conversion clock this Monday. ERCOT’s Board Item 14 (slides dated 11 Sep for the 14–15 Board) published the first public Batch Zero conditional megawatt split — 204 projects / 66.4 GW base load and 158 / ~125–128 GW studied, against ~302 GW excluded — and opened a 461-site community-impact survey under the Abbott audit, with energization still paused and December 10 verification reports due. Separately, press reports the PUCT on Friday approved AEP/CPS Howard–Solstice (~370 mi 765 kV, Docket 59336) contingent on landowner route mods; Route 4 Mod 1 hit Interchange the same day, though the written Order was not yet stamped as of this morning. Project 58481 (§25.194) still shows no Order Adopting on Interchange through item 217. The Silicon Tape is a clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints (CoreWeave NA/EU spots visible again in static HTML).

United States / Texas: PUCT 59336 Howard–Solstice 765 kV: press-approved 11 Sep with landowner route mods; Route 4 Mod 1 filed; written Order pending on Interchange.
